title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Jewelry, Furs and Watches Cap on First Claim Decisions
content:
On a first decision on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the jewelry, furs and watches value is capped at the decision's jewelry cap. The decision's jewelry cap is the level's jewelry, furs and watches sublimit multiplied by a figure that depends on how long the plan had been in effect on the loss date.

## Schedule

| Whole months from the plan's effective date to the loss date | Decision's jewelry cap |
| --- | --- |
| 36 or more | the jewelry sublimit multiplied by 1.5 |
| at least 12 and fewer than 36 | the jewelry sublimit multiplied by 1.2 |
| fewer than 12 | the jewelry sublimit (multiplied by 1) |

## Notes

1. The months are counted from the plan's effective date, not its enrollment date, to the loss date of the claim, not the handling date.
2. At 36 whole months the cap is 1.5 times the sublimit; at 35 it is 1.2 times. At 12 whole months it is 1.2 times; at 11 it is the sublimit itself.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

With a jewelry sublimit of 800.00, a plan effective 40 whole months before the loss date gives a cap of 1,200.00; 20 months gives 960.00; 6 months gives 800.00. Jewelry assessed at 1,050.00 is then counted at 1,050.00, 960.00 and 800.00 respectively.
